standard_prerequisites.name: The exactness of the sheaf of homomorphisms in the first variable for a right exact sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source line 4006 as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the two exact rows of the diagram whose outer vertical arrows are computed directly.

core_obligations: Reduce to a global presentation: since colimits commute with restriction to opens, the proof assumes the module has a presentation by two finite direct sums of the structure sheaf (proof lines 3990-4003)

Write both rows exactly: the sheaf of homomorphisms out of a finite direct sum of structure sheaves is a finite direct sum of the target, so the exactness statement for homomorphisms gives exact sequences for the module and for each term of the colimit (proof lines 4004-4013)

Use exactness of filtered colimits: filtered colimits are exact, so the colimit of the first sequences is exact as well, and it maps to the second sequence by the canonical maps (proof lines 4014-4024)
Conclude: the outer two vertical arrows are isomorphisms because they are colimits of identities, hence so is the middle one (proof lines 4030-4031)
proof_roadmap: 由 colim 与开集限制交换，可设 F 有整体展示 ⊕_{j≤m}O_X → ⊕_{i≤n}O_X → F → 0。
因 Hom(-,-) 与有限直和交换且 Hom(O_X,-) = id，由 Hom 在第一个变量上的正合性得两行正合列；再由滤过 colim 正合，比较图中两侧竖直箭头是同构（colim of identity），故中间箭头也是同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the sheaf of homomorphisms out of a finitely presented module into a filtered colimit of modules is the colimit of the sheaves of homomorphisms into the terms (author lemma at source lines 3975-3987, label lemma-hom-finite-presentation-colimit). The proof (source lines 3989-4032) reduces to a module with a global presentation, writes the exact sequences for the module and for each term using the behaviour of the sheaf of homomorphisms on finite direct sums and its exactness in the first variable, and then compares the colimit of the first with the second, using exactness of filtered colimits and the fact that the outer arrows are colimits of identities (proof lines 4004-4031). The comparison of the two exact sequences is the content. H2.
